title: D&D Playground Endpoints
summary: This module provides API endpoints for interacting with the D&D Playground, enabling streaming responses for gameplay and retrieving metadata about available presets and configurations.

nodes.label: D&D Playground Stream
nodes.title: D&D Playground Stream Endpoint
nodes.description: Handles streaming requests for the D&D Playground, providing real-time event updates to clients.

nodes.label: D&D Playground Metadata
nodes.title: D&D Playground Metadata Endpoint
nodes.description: Retrieves metadata for the D&D Playground, including default questions, alignments, and configuration paths.

nodes.label: Load Playground Bundle
nodes.title: Load D&D Playground Bundle
nodes.description: Loads the D&D Playground configuration bundle, including presets and questions, from the file system.

nodes.label: Streaming Response
nodes.title: FastAPI Streaming Response
nodes.description: Utilizes FastAPI's StreamingResponse to send server-sent events (SSE) to the client.

nodes.label: HTTP Exception Handling
nodes.title: FastAPI HTTP Exception
nodes.description: Handles and raises HTTP exceptions for error conditions, such as file not found errors.

nodes.label: D&D Playground Core Logic
nodes.title: D&D Playground Core Logic
nodes.description: Encapsulates the core logic for D&D playground interactions, including grid generation and alpha calculations.

groups.label: API Interface

groups.description: User-facing endpoints for interacting with the D&D Playground functionality.

groups.title: Data Loading and Configuration Management
